source_snapshot.procedure: From BMC SSH query Redfish root and MetricReports/All, read OAM_4 GPU_4_MEMORY_TEMP, run AGFHC HBM for 20 minutes, read the same sensor during stress and verify it rises.
source_snapshot.criteria: Readings lie within lower/upper limits and are non-NULL/nonzero; AGFHC has no failure and meets its own criteria.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES but only performs one insecure fixed-IP bulk query; omits root, direct sensor, AGFHC, before/during correlation and stress health.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; restores endpoint/schema/count/limits, protected Redfish, mapped sensor and approved monitored 20-minute HBM workload.

old_problem: The source assumes HTTP/-k, fixed 192.168.31.1, 732 metrics and OAM_4/GPU_4 without authoritative topology/schema. Per-metric units/bounds and legitimate zero exceptions are absent. DeepSeek drops most coverage, while temperature rise alone cannot prove bulk telemetry or workload health.
disposition_reason: The purpose and method are clear and missing endpoint, metric inventory, limits, sensor identity and AGFHC package are runtime Project Configuration. The review retains all three Redfish reads, the full 20-minute HBM workload and same-resource correlation. A live topology-derived count replaces fixed 732, and per-metric semantics replace an unsafe blanket nonzero rule without inventing thresholds.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2050, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2051 / Wistron-AMD SVM-01062-V003 / abcc79abcacb6c39 was directly read from XLSX.
Metric count and resource names vary with topology/firmware; completeness is measured against the signed live inventory rather than assuming 732, OAM_4 or GPU_4.
Zero is valid for some counters/status encodings, so each metric needs its own unit, bounds and null/zero policy under ED-15.

Before/during temperature samples must resolve to the same physical OAM/GPU sensor, units and timestamp; rise proves responsiveness only when AGFHC is actively healthy and thermal/power limits remain valid.
The source 20-minute duration is preserved; no short smoke run may substitute. Protected authenticated TLS replaces HTTP/-k/fixed credentials and logs are not cleared.
No BMC/SUT login, Redfish read, AGFHC stress, telemetry sampling, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: UBB/OAM telemetry inventory and HBM-correlated GPU memory-temperature response
test_case.purpose: Validate the complete topology-approved UBB/OAM telemetry report against per-metric semantics and prove the exact mapped GPU memory-temperature sensor responds during a healthy 20-minute AGFHC HBM workload without exceeding approved limits.
required_package: Exact row-2050 variant plus SUT/BMC/UBB/OAM/GPU/firmware/driver identities
Approved VNIC endpoint/schema, protected TLS/authentication and live required metric inventory
Per-metric resource identity, unit, bounds, null policy and legitimate-zero/status exceptions
Signed physical OAM/GPU to memory-temperature URI map plus sample cadence/direction/delta policy
AGFHC binary/version/checksum, exact HBM target/pass criteria, 20-minute authorization, no-conflicting-load and thermal/power abort/recovery rules
test_case.test_command: PACKAGE-AND-STRESS-GATED; preserve logs and verify identities. Over protected authenticated TLS, GET the approved Redfish root and complete MetricReports/All resource, following any collection links; reconcile every required metric to live topology and its unit/bounds/null-zero policy. Resolve the signed physical OAM/GPU memory-temperature URI and capture timestamped baseline. After explicit authorization, start the exact AGFHC `hbm:d=20m` target and monitor workload, GPU, temperature and power for the full 20 minutes; while it is demonstrably active, sample the same URI at the approved cadence. Validate bulk metrics, same-sensor response and AGFHC criteria independently. No fixed-IP assumption, log clearing, insecure SSH/TLS or automatic restart.
test_case.expected_result: The protected Redfish service returns the complete live topology-approved inventory with every value valid for its unit/bounds/null-zero policy; the same physical GPU memory-temperature resource remains valid and exhibits the approved workload-correlated response during a successful full 20-minute HBM run, without thermal/power/GPU/log failure.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete live inventory reconciliation, every per-metric rule, immutable same-sensor mapping, full-duration healthy AGFHC evidence and approved temperature response within limits. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/invalid metric, schema/unit/bound mismatch, wrong sensor, no approved response, AGFHC failure or thermal/power/GPU anomaly. Missing map/threshold/package/approval is NOT READY; temperature rise alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Use protected TLS/authentication and mapped endpoints; never assume fixed IP/resource/count or expose credentials.
Run the exact 20-minute HBM workload only after authorization with no conflicting load and continuous thermal/power/GPU monitoring.
Stop on schema/count/identity mismatch, invalid telemetry, workload error or thermal/power abort; preserve first evidence.
No log clearing, automatic stress restart or shortened substitute run.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and full SUT/BMC/UBB/OAM/GPU identity
Approved endpoint/schema, live metric inventory and per-metric unit/bounds/null-zero policy
Redacted Redfish root, complete metric report and mapped sensor responses with timestamps/hashes
Same-sensor before/during series plus workload/thermal/power/GPU correlation and bulk-metric analysis
No-clear/no-restart audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On API/schema/identity mismatch, workload failure or thermal/power/GPU anomaly, stop the stress once using the approved termination path, preserve raw telemetry/workload/log state and close sessions. Do not restart AGFHC or clear evidence. Use the pre-approved cooling/service recovery and escalate the exact metric or GPU identity.

source_conflict.reason: Live topology/schema and per-metric rules replace fixed 732/OAM_4/GPU_4 assumptions, while complete Redfish plus 20-minute workload coverage replaces DeepSeek's partial insecure query.

blocked.reason: The telemetry/workload method, evidence and recovery are complete; endpoint/schema/inventory/map, AGFHC and limits are runtime Project inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Protected endpoint/schema, live metric inventory and per-metric rules, OAM/GPU sensor map, AGFHC package/criteria, response policy, aborts and authorization.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO TOPOLOGY-DERIVED TELEMETRY/HBM CORRELATION; NO LOGIN, REDFISH READ, STRESS, SAMPLE, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
